notes.title: Post-Launch-Patch 🚀🩹
notes.content:
Hello Adventurer,

it is dangerous to go alone, take this patch! 🩹

This patch brings a few bugfixes and re-balancing, especially the achievements.
After a bit of discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2237460/discussions/0/4635986342046608034/?tscn=1731234730]on the steam forum[/url] I think we made it better.

[h2]Patchnotes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Re-Balance Achievements #157
[*] refill time-bar on timeout #150 #101
[*] fix Auto-Biome in Enemy description #149
[*] only 1 char + level in demo info-text #158
[/list]
